rules: When the learner writes JSON, ask them to read it back as data types (string, number, boolean, null, array, object) before you comment on it.

placement.intro: Find out whether the learner has written JSON by hand before. Ask at most two short questions.

json.tagline: From the six value types to fixing a real config file.
json.placementHints: Start at what-is-json for anyone new to JSON. Start at fix-the-config, skipping what-is-json, only if the learner already edits JSON files by hand and can name its value types.

badges.name: Fix the config
badges.description: Fixed a type bug in an AI-written JSON config file and added a correctly typed setting.

criteria.narrative: Awarded when the learner completes the Fix the config lesson: the planted port type bug is fixed and the added timeout setting passes the automatic file checks.

badges.name: Read and write JSON
badges.description: Completed the Read and write JSON path.

criteria.narrative: Awarded when every lesson in the Read and write JSON path is satisfied: the automatic file checks pass and the learner's explanations meet the agent rubric of each checkpoint.
